titulo: Carta — Bispo do Xadrez (ilustração da janela)
prompt: Richly painted anime-inspired storybook illustration for a dark fantasy tarot card, full-bleed vertical scene that fills the whole tall narrow image edge to edge, portrait composition with the main subject in the center and atmospheric detail rising to the top and settling at the bottom. Fine ink linework, painterly gouache shading, intricate details, whimsical but dark mood, deep indigo and violet palette with crimson accents and warm candle-gold highlights, drifting glowing motes and soft fog. World of DEVO: a survival game of borrowed time where every player wears a ticking timer on the wrist, with clocks, tarot and masks everywhere. Chess collection: the scene stands on a vast polished black-and-white marble chessboard floor stretching into violet fog, colossal carved chess pieces loom in the background, cold moonlight with crimson and gold glints. A small white cross the size of a palm fixed to a stone pillar in a dark cathedral corridor, glowing alarm red with ripples of sound bursting from it, the long shadow of an intruder creeping closer, tall bishop chess pieces like statues along the arches. Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no numerals, no signature, no watermark, no logo, no card frame, no border, no ornamental frame, no panels, not a collage, not photorealistic, no 3d render.
